faq.title: Invoice Generator Excel Alternative FAQs
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about moving away from spreadsheet invoicing.

items.question: Why shouldn't I just use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for invoices?
items.answer: Spreadsheets are prone to hidden formula errors, accidentally deleted calculation cells, awkward page breaks when exported to PDF, and lack responsive mobile editing. Our dedicated tool automates math and formatting cleanly.

items.question: Can I export my invoice data as JSON for backup?
items.answer: Yes. You can export and import your full invoice details as structured JSON with a single click, providing portable data backups without spreadsheets.

items.question: Can I use this tool completely offline?
items.answer: Yes. Because the calculation and PDF engine run client-side in your browser, once loaded you can generate and print invoices even without an active internet connection.

items.question: Does this tool support multiple currencies and international taxes?
items.answer: Yes. Switch easily between 30+ major world currencies and configure custom percentage or flat tax rates (GST, VAT, Sales Tax) without writing spreadsheet formulas.
